build_dashscope_image_config: build a DashScope image generation config that transforms OpenAI params to DashScope format
transform_image_generation_request: transform an OpenAI-style image generation request into DashScope multimodal-generation API format
transform_image_generation_response: transform a DashScope image generation response into a litellm ImageResponse object
map_openai_params: map OpenAI image generation params like size and n to DashScope-compatible parameters
validate_environment: validate the DashScope API environment by checking and setting the required API key and headers
